mapping_json.fidelity_notes: GX-03 GX-07 (corpus gx). HOT-FLAG 7 RESOLVED: queried kit_mapping for b01/b02 melee precedents -> Tempest Flurry maps melee_arc (gemling-stacker precedent, SAME skill name, 'rapid melee attacks with area of effect' + flurry-with-AoE-finisher shape); the ALTERNATIVE was ice-strike-invoker's melee_strike, but that member is for Ice Strike specifically ('small close contact' single-contact), a DIFFERENT skill -- Tempest Flurry's multi-hit-rhythm-with-erupting-finisher is the melee_arc swing-family, not a single strike. Chose melee_arc; noted the melee_strike alternative. shock->sunder (S-A BINDING; 'shock vs freeze' in corpus mech_note is a control-descriptor, NOT fetched paralysis attestation -> sunder). Combo/Power-Charge builder-spender -> accumulator + spend-burst (Section-B). Charged Staff -> self_buff (charge-consuming maintain-buff; R-M9-adjacent buff). TEMPORAL_CHARGE routes the charge engine; MOMENTUM_CASCADE routes the rhythm-cadence ramp. Invoker ascendancy -> t4 via 5 (R-M1). eras 0.1/0.2/0.5 CONFIRMED.
